body:
Tested locally on the TPS demo on Linux + NVIDIA, it works as expected. Code looks good to me at a glance.

Some feedback:

- The **Shader Baker > Export** option should be renamed to **Shader Baker > Enabled** option, for consistency with other boolean options in export presets.
- I get a warning when exporting a project with shader baking enabled (the project is using Forward+ and the default drivers):
```
  WARNING: core/config/project_settings.cpp:405 - Property not found: 'rendering/rendering_device/driver.linux'.
```

Manually updating the ``project.godot`` to these configs fixes the cache misses on Android:

```
[rendering]

renderer/rendering_method="mobile"
lights_and_shadows/directional_shadow/size=2048
lights_and_shadows/directional_shadow/soft_shadow_filter_quality=0
lights_and_shadows/positional_shadow/soft_shadow_filter_quality=0
reflections/sky_reflections/texture_array_reflections=false
reflections/sky_reflections/ggx_samples=16
reflections/reflection_atlas/reflection_size=128
shading/overrides/force_lambert_over_burley=true
environment/ssao/quality=0
environment/ssil/quality=0
environment/glow/upscale_mode=0
lights_and_shadows/positional_shadow/atlas_size=2048
```

Now I'm not certain which ones specifically were resulting in the cache misses.  What I did was go through the godot code base for all specific ``.mobile`` configs and make sure I set them globally in the ``project.godot``

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7788af93-e7b1-4225-b2f9-ef7063b825bb)

The important ones I suspect are in ``rendering_server.cpp`` and maybe ``scene_tree.cpp``.

So I guess the suggested change would be to have a means of detecting if we are exporting for mobile platforms, load the proper settings, and bake the shaders with those settings.
2 ugly bugs crept in for the Metal support, that were way longer to find than I am willing to admit...
LGTM – all my feedback has been incorporated. Thanks @DarioSamo!

We need to change SHADER_SPIRV_VERSION_1_5 to SHADER_SPIRV_VERSION_1_3 in order to be compatible with the Vulkan version 1.1 we are targetting.  Details here: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/102552#issuecomment-2912789702

Overall this looks amazing. I left one comment about FSR that I think we should discuss tomorrow.

Also, just to confirm, we are officially dropping MoltenVK support for the Forward+ renderer with this change right?
